# setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)

```

# Problem 1

ny_noaa with `r ncol(ny_noaa)`variables and `r nrow(ny_noaa)` obervations includes daily observation data in different weather stations in New York over 1981–2010 ,such as weather station id，Precipitation (tenths of mm)，date，snowfall,snow depth,maximum temperature and minimum temperature.

The data size is very large and many missing data exist, especially among tmax and tmin.

```{r}
data("ny_noaa")
ny <- ny_noaa

ny_clean = ny |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date),
    day = day(date),
    prcp_mm = as.numeric(prcp)/ 10,         
    tmax_c = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,          
    tmin_c = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,           
    snow_mm = snow,              
    snwd_mm = snwd
  ) |>
  select(id, date, year, month, day, prcp_mm, snow_mm, snwd_mm, tmax_c, tmin_c)


snow_common = ny_clean |>
  count(snow_mm, sort = TRUE) |>
  head(10)
```
The most common snowfall values are 0 (no snow) and 25mm, 13mm, 51mm, etc. Zero is by far the most frequent because most days have no snowfall.

```{r}
jan_july <- ny_clean |>
  filter(month == 1 | month == 7, !is.na(tmax_c)) |>
  group_by(id, month, year) |>
  summarise(avg_tmax = mean(tmax_c, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(month_lab = factor(month, levels = c(1, 7), labels = c("January", "July")))

ggplot(jan_july, aes(x = year, y = avg_tmax, group = id)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), se = FALSE, color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ month_lab) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Maximum Temperature by Station",
    subtitle = "January vs July, 1981–2010",
    x = "Year", y = "Average Tmax (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

January temperatures show more year-to-year fluctuation and a slight upward trend at some stations. July temperatures are higher and more stable. A few stations appear as outliers, one station with unusually low value around 1987 July and one statioj with very lower tmax around 1982 Jan in particular.
